measurement: TUI process launch to connected home markers (connected, SESSIONS, VEASEL); local backend already healthy; one full keyboard smoke journey per sample

interactiveCoverage.journey: connected home -> seeded session -> Ctrl+R review -> approve workspace edit -> session composer

firstRunCoverage.journey: clean profile -> /connect -> local provider -> model discovery -> new session -> prompt -> persisted reply

restartCoverage.journey: conversation persisted -> backend SIGINT/terminate -> restart on same data dir -> TUI reopen -> transcript + ready composer, no new prompt sent

killRecoveryCoverage.journey: async slow turn running -> backend SIGKILL mid-operation -> restart on same data dir -> operation uncertain with error, conversation unchanged

exclusions: Not render FPS, model/token latency, coding-task quality, or a cross-runner performance guarantee.
